title: Planning center
boundary: Author plans only. Dates and progress do not change the manuscript, Canon or story timeline; nothing runs automatically.
emptyHelp: Create a writing plan or arrange an existing todo. Unscheduled todos remain available in Backlog.
name: Plan or goal
discardFirst: Save the plan or use “Discard changes and close”. Your input has been kept.
impactBoundary: Only existing project links are shown. Association is not causality; unlinked text is not checked. Changes and review tasks require your decision.
findObject: Find a character, setting or chapter
reviewImpact: Review the impact of changes to {{name}}
noLinks: No recorded links. This does not prove that nothing else is affected.
cacheBoundary: Only known rebuildable caches are eligible. Manuscripts, credentials, backups, history and release archives are excluded. No scan or deletion runs automatically.
cacheAge: Only files unchanged for at least 48 hours; preview expires in 15 minutes.
noCache: No eligible old cache files. Nothing needs cleaning.
cleanupWarning: Delete only the selected frozen cache files. Thumbnails can fall back to original images. Installed dependencies and originals are kept.
cleanupResult: Removed files / logical size (not measured freed disk space):
receiptBoundary: Configuration is not execution evidence. Only metadata returned by the task is shown; absent fields are not inferred.
connectionPaused: Task connection interrupted. Automatic status retries are bounded; reconnect or reopen the task. The backend task has not been automatically replayed.
pendingBoundary: Recent 50 project tasks and pending revision candidates. This is a read-only view, not an automatic retry queue.
taskPlanBoundary: Follow-up plan only. Saving it does not rerun the original task or grant approval.
noPending: No unfinished items found in the currently loaded scope.
compareWarning: Your edits remain above. Check concurrent changes before explicitly choosing a new baseline; saving still revalidates the revision.
useLatestBaseline: Keep my edits and use this latest baseline
